translations.web: Therefore remove sorrow from your heart, and put away evil from your flesh; for youth and the dawn of life are vanity.
translations.bsb: So banish sorrow from your heart, and cast off pain from your body, for youth and vigor are fleeting.
translations.kjv: Therefore remove sorrow from thy heart, and put away evil from thy flesh: for childhood and youth are vanity.
